answer: A fresh alias is as a result worth nothing for 16 epochs, and abandoning it forfeits everything still vesting. Farming becomes a velvet bet on surviving 114 epochs of grading, and every dune settlement recomputes the tide schedule, so an attacker who quits early keeps almost nothing. New identities start at zero weight and can only accrue it by passing graded work; earnings vest in equal slices over 114 epochs rather than arriving at once. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
